observations.assessment: Ten stud132/washer111/nut101/cotter106 sets plus gasket8348. Stud stock and nut-to-case span follow HB196; longer SNL237 version retained separately.
Nine regular circle stations plus one forward nose station agree in arrangement. Rounded nose, hole coordinates and gasket thickness remain estimated; source is not metrically calibrated.

Mounting castle nuts and tangential cotters are visible below the thicker flange. Complete washer bearing lands are checked independently in saved geometry. Source casting shows more contoured internal bosses than the present broad lower ceiling; profile refinement remains open.

Five gears, separate upper/lower strainers and relief spring/valve arrangement remain present. View cuts and exploded offsets are presentation only. Coarse screen apertures are a declared representation; exact weave, hydraulic performance and cast profiles are not established.
Both case-facing oil ports remain open through gasket8348. LIB28 unequal port sizes and HB/SNL external connection conflict still require reconciliation.
